title: XPTerrainBuilder airport entry manifest (xptl-airport-1)
description: entries/<ICAO>/<pack>/<pack version>/v<N>/manifest.json. Checked by XPTerrainBuilder's patch_library.checks; this schema documents it.

tile.description: the tile the airport was built in

signature.description: pack signature: apt.dat block, pristine pack DSF(s), borrowed Global Airports block, 1302 flatten

law.description: the auto-patch law that solved it; a different law re-solves

min_engine.description: an older app warns before using it

publisher.description: GitHub login; must be the pull request's author

licence.description: ODbL-1.0 when every source is open; per-source-noncommercial when any source is non-commercial (licences.json 'noncommercial'): the entry is offered for non-commercial use under each source's terms

credit.description: the attribution credited (licences.json's, else the provider's)

terms.description: the URL of the source's terms (licences.json)

noncommercial.description: true when any source is non-commercial; marks the whole entry
